name: vscode-agentshield
description: Zero-leak secret defense, status bar alert, and environment guard for Cursor, VS Code, and AI Coding Agents.

commands.title: AgentShield: Scan Current Workspace for Secrets
AgentShield: Redact Exposed Secrets in Active File

agentshield.enableStatusBar.description: Show AgentShield status and real-time shielded secret count in the status bar.

agentshield.autoScanOnSave.description: Automatically audit files for leaked credentials when saved.

agentshield.realTimeRedact.description: Warn and offer 1-click auto-redaction when a real API key or token is pasted into editor or prompt box.
